Title: Large storage for Azure Database for MariaDB

Body.Content:
Support for up to 16 TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS in Azure Database for MariaDB is now available in preview. This functionality not only provides five times more storage for database servers, but also more than triples the available IOPS. This ensures that you can run your most demanding large-scale workloads on Azure Database for MariaDB. 

Learn more in the service documentation.
